Pet carriers, some useful tips at dusk
We write to travelers

Simple notice for pet travel

Travelers need to know that companion animal bookings must match the carrier rules and the comfort needs of each pet before departure. We are sorry for any confusion this may cause, and we want to keep the process easy and fair for everyone using Aurelia Skyways.

For cats, please review the space and weight limits with care before you arrive at the airport. <<FACT F061>> The crate should also meet the size rule for the longest side, and it must be sturdy, clean, and well ventilated. <<FACT F067>> If a pet seems anxious, the travel plan may need a calmer setup, because the right carrier helps reduce stress and keeps the journey safer.

Please pack soft bedding, fresh water access, and any approved comfort items that help the animal settle. We also ask travelers to check that doors, locks, and handles are secure, since small faults can create avoidable problems at check-in. If you are unsure about a carrier or a pet's readiness, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can guide you with practical support.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel so we can help you prepare properly.
